dataIdInfo.idPurp: Specific physical location which Reneco and Reneco founders find interesting to use in the mapping production and web GIS.
dataIdInfo.idAbs:
The RENECO POLYGONOF INTEREST feature class is a specific physical location which Reneco and Reneco founders find interesting to use in the mapping production and web GIS. Irrigated fields, breeding infrastructure, houbara prerelease station, houbara holding siteare all examples of polygonof interest.

The feature class is stored in geographic coordinate system WGS 1984 (EPSG: 4326).

Each record has the geometry of a singlepolygonand represents the location of a Reneco polygonof interest.

This layer was made from theinternal and external sources which were downloaded and copied into a single layer.

This feature class is mostly useful in all Reneco centres for survey, release strategy maps.
